name: basic_product_information
ddl:
CREATE TABLE "basic_product_information" (
"Transaction Number" TEXT,
  "Agricultural Product Name" TEXT,
  "Product Specifications" TEXT,
  "Product Grade" TEXT,
  "Place of Origin" TEXT,
  "Seller's Farm" TEXT
)

name: core_transaction_information
ddl:
CREATE TABLE "core_transaction_information" (
"Transaction Number" TEXT,
  "Transaction Date" TIMESTAMP,
  "Sales Quantity (units)" INTEGER,
  "Unit Price (yuan)" REAL,
  "Total Transaction Amount" INTEGER,
  "Sales Channel" TEXT,
  "Buyer Type" TEXT,
  "Buyer Region" TEXT,
  "Payment Method" TEXT,
  "Payment Terms (days)" INTEGER,
  "Promotion" TEXT,
  "Transaction Status" TEXT,
  "Salesperson" TEXT
)

name: market_and_quality_feedback_inf
ddl:
CREATE TABLE "market_and_quality_feedback_inf" (
"Transaction Number" TEXT,
  "Season label" TEXT,
  "Market price (CNY/kg)" REAL,
  "Price fluctuation rate" TEXT,
  "Inventory status" TEXT,
  "Quality inspection results" TEXT,
  "Customer Satisfaction" TEXT,
  "Repurchase intention" TEXT
)
